title: Billing Department Statement: Amount of the PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) Activation Payment
content:
The activation payment is the member's own payment that starts PrePay Power (Prepaid Metering) on an enrollment awaiting activation; it is credited in full to the prepaid balance and carries no recovery portion.

The activation payment the desk quotes is the opening target less the prepaid balance standing on the enrollment, rounded to the cent, raised to the tier's activation payment minimum when it comes to less and lowered to the tier's largest single payment when it comes to more. The opening target is the cover days multiplied by the opening daily cost, rounded to the cent. The cover days are 7. The opening daily cost is the total of the usage lines of the most recent standard bill of the enrolled service account divided by 30, the most recent standard bill being the latest dated bill of usage lines on that account; the opening daily cost is not rounded on its own, and the rounding to the cent falls on the opening target and again on the difference.

The tier's activation payment minimum and its largest single payment are the PrePay Power figures of the tier the enrollment was assigned. The minimum and the largest payment act on the rounded difference only: the quote is never below the minimum and never above the largest single payment.

### Worked figures (hypothetical records; for illustration a tier with an activation payment minimum of 50.00 and a largest single payment of 500.00)

| | Case A | Case B | Case C |
|---|---|---|---|
| Usage lines of the most recent standard bill | 138.60 | 300.00 | 300.00 |
| Opening daily cost: divided by 30 | 4.62 | 10.00 | 10.00 |
| Cover days | 7 | 7 | 7 |
| Opening target, to the cent | 32.34 | 70.00 | 70.00 |
| Prepaid balance standing on the enrollment | 0.00 | 12.50 | 40.00 |
| Opening target less that balance | 32.34 | 57.50 | 30.00 |
| Quoted activation payment | 50.00 (raised to the minimum) | 57.50 | 50.00 (raised to the minimum) |

Case B reads: 300.00 divided by 30 is 10.00 a day; 7 days of it is 70.00; less the 12.50 already standing on the enrollment leaves 57.50, which lies between 50.00 and 500.00 and is quoted as it stands.
